title: Part 10
content_zh: Meng Haoran failed the imperial examination and spent his life wandering the mountains, writing poems about mist, moonlight, and the sorrow of saying goodbye to friends at dawn. He never held office, yet his name outlasted every emperor of the Tang dynasty.
